articles.title: Spain’s PM says no evidence ‘whatsoever’ Morocco behind Ceuta border breach
articles.description:
Pedro Sánchez continues to defend Rabat after police report claiming border forces helped 70,000 cross border

Europe live – latest updates

Spain has seen no evidence “whatsoever” that Morocco planned or facilitated a mass border breach into its north African territory of Ceuta, the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has told parliament.
The address on Thursday followed the emergence of a police report, commissioned by a judge and widely quoted in the media, claiming Moroccan border forces had actively aided about 70,000 people to cross the border in late July.

articles.title: ‘We continue to suffer’: victims of apartheid-era Sharpeville massacre demand compensation
articles.description:
Claim relating to 1960 attack on hundreds of protesters part of wave of litigation over apartheid crimes in South Africa
The day dawned brightly on 21 March 1960, as residents of the South African township of Sharpeville gathered to protest against pass laws, which forced “Black, Indian and Coloured” South Africans to carry documents at all times specifying where they were allowed to be.
Abraham Mofokeng joined the march, one of dozens organised nationwide by the Pan Africanist Congress (PAC), a breakaway group from the African National Congress (ANC). “The weather was very nice, the sun was out. You could not have suspected that the day would go so horribly,” said Mofokeng, who was then a 20-year-old factory worker.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「私たちは苦しみ続けている」：アパルトヘイト時代のシャープビル虐殺犠牲者が補償を要求
articles.summary: 1960年のシャープビル虐殺の犠牲者たちが、アパルトヘイト時代の犯罪に対する一連の訴訟の一部として補償を求めている。

articles.title: New constitution in Guinea-Bissau will undermine democracy, opponents say
articles.description:
Referendum result means fewer seats in parliament and new rules on candidates, ahead of December elections
Guinea-Bissau voters have approved a new constitution, which critics say will undermine democracy, that significantly expands presidential powers ahead of elections due in December.
According to provisional results, 70% of voters approved sweeping changes in the tiny west African state’s first constitutional amendment since revisions that ended the one-party socialist state more than three decades ago.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
articles.description:
Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities
Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found.
Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network, found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.description:
Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risks

Airlink insists flyby conducted according to regulations

A pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. The flyby by two Embraer jets, operated by the local airline Airlink, happened on Saturday before the second rugby union Test between South Africa and New Zealand in Cape Town.
The flight tracking service Flightradar24 estimated that the lead jet passed just 41-46 feet (12-14 metres) above the roof of Cape Town Stadium, with the crowd and the world’s top-ranked rugby teams below. The second jet, which was very close behind, flew through a cloud of pink dust that shot up from the stadium roof as part of the show.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Apocalypse prep or pure pragmatism: what is behind Peter Thiel’s move to Argentina?
articles.description:
Relocation coincides with proposed laws that opponents say would entrench power of US tech billionaires in country
Dozens of protesters converged on Peter Thiel’s mansion in Buenos Aires this week after a congressional session raised questions about the billionaire’s presence in the country.
In white masks, they held signs saying “Peter Thief” and “No to the Peter Thiel law” in front of the wrought-iron gates of the $12m (£8.9m) residence, which Thiel bought in April as he moved his family to Argentina.

articles.title: The US and Venezuela: a century-old relationship drenched in oil
articles.description:
A visual look at how Washington’s relationship with Caracas has gone from cordial to ‘predatory’

Trump ally defends Venezuela oil deal amid ‘gunpoint diplomacy’ criticism

Written in the middle of the last century, the US Department of State memo conveys its message in a curt and undiplomatically honest tone: the glue that binds Washington to Caracas is, and is always likely to be, oil.
“All US policies toward Venezuela are affected in greater or less degree by the objective of assuring an adequate supply of petroleum for the US,” the 1950 document reads.

articles.title: Apple Maps renames Lake Ontario as ‘Lake America’ for US users after Trump order
articles.description:
Tech company submits to controversial Trump order to rename body of water amid US trade spat with Canada
Apple has renamed Lake Ontario as “Lake America” for US users of its Maps app, after an executive order from Donald Trump to change the name of the Great Lake amid his trade spat with Canada.
The Apple Maps app now displays the controversial new name for the lake, which sits between New York state and the Canadian province of Ontario, for users in the US. Apple users outside the country will still see the Lake Ontario name.

articles.title: Trump ally defends Venezuela oil deal amid ‘gunpoint diplomacy’ criticism

The US energy secretary, Chris Wright, has denied Washington is seeking to commandeer huge quantities of Venezuelan oil, amid growing criticism of Donald Trump’s energy deal with the country’s interim leaders.
“Absolutely not,” Wright replied when asked by a CNBC journalist if the US was engaged in a “heavy-handed” attempt to “take” Venezuelan oil in violation of the South American country’s constitution.

articles.title: Pete Hegseth criticized for body-shaming Canadian cadets: ‘Literally they’re kids’
articles.description:

On Monday night, Hegseth posted on X a photograph of two people in uniform with a Canadian flag and the caption “this is real”, an apparent attempt at mocking the country’s armed forces amid the Trump administration’s trade spat with its northern neighbor.

articles.titleJa: ドイツでパブの「愛された」店長が刺殺される
articles.summary: ドイツのローゼンハイム駅で、パブの店長レベッカ・ブロックさん（31歳）が刺殺された痛ましい事件。

articles.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
articles.description: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.
articles.titleJa: ローゼンバーグ氏：プーチン大統領の英国への暗黙の脅威は、ロシアの対西側諸国キャンペーンの一部
articles.summary: プーチン大統領が英国に発した暗黙の脅威は、ロシアが西側諸国に対して展開するキャンペーンの一環であると指摘されている。

articles.title: 'Humble but ambitious' - the return of fallen giants Schalke
articles.description: One of Germany's fallen giants, Schalke are back in the Bundesliga after a complicated few years.
articles.titleJa: 「謙虚だが野心的」－堕ちた巨人シャルケの復帰
articles.summary: ドイツのサッカー名門クラブ、シャルケが数年の苦難を経てブンデスリーガに復帰した。

articles.title: Why did Modi urge Putin to end Ukraine war - and will he listen?
articles.description: BBC correspondents in Delhi and Moscow look at why the Indian PM made a very public peace plea to his Russian ally.
articles.titleJa: モディ首相はなぜプーチン大統領にウクライナ戦争終結を促したのか、そしてプーチンは耳を傾けるのか？
articles.summary: インドのモディ首相がロシアのプーチン大統領に対し、ウクライナ戦争の終結を公に訴えた背景と、その影響について考察する。

articles.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
articles.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.
articles.titleJa: 「手から滑り落ちた」－北キプロス沖でフェリー沈没、子供たちが行方不明
articles.summary: 北キプロス沖でフェリーが沈没し、20人が行方不明、8人が死亡。両親が語るように、幼い子供たちも行方不明となっている。

articles.title: Remarkable US oil deal puzzles analysts - and angers many Venezuelans
articles.description: Amounting to 65 billion barrels of crude, the deal is labelled by one ex-envoy as a colonialist "fever dream".
articles.titleJa: 米国の画期的な石油取引がアナリストを困惑させ、多くのベネズエラ人を怒らせる
articles.summary: 米国とベネズエラ間の650億バレルに及ぶ石油取引は、植民地主義的だと批判され、ベネズエラ国民の怒りを買っている。

articles.title: Former Ecuadorian president imprisoned for corruption
articles.description: Lenín Moreno denies taking bribes from a Chinese firm to secure a contract to build a hydroelectric plant.
articles.titleJa: エクアドル元大統領が汚職で投獄される
articles.summary: レニン・モレノ元エクアドル大統領が、中国企業からの賄賂を受け取ったとして汚職の罪で投獄された。本人は容疑を否認している。

articles.title: Colombia's new president approves extradition of rebel leaders to US
articles.description: It is a step towards ending a plan to stop violence by bringing rebel and criminal groups to the negotiating table.
articles.titleJa: コロンビア新大統領、反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認
articles.summary: コロンビアの新大統領は、暴力停止計画の一環として反政府勢力指導者の米国への引き渡しを承認した。

articles.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
articles.description: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.
articles.titleJa: マラドーナの「神の手」ボールが250万ポンドで落札
articles.summary: ディエゴ・マラドーナが1986年W杯で「神の手」ゴールを決めたサッカーボールが、オークションで250万ポンド（約4億円）で落札された。

articles.title: US sanctions more Cuban companies and officials
articles.description: An international socialist institute and Cuba's construction ministry are subject to the latest US sanctions, Marco Rubio announces.
articles.titleJa: 米国、キューバ企業と当局者に追加制裁を課す
articles.summary: 米国は、国際社会主義研究所とキューバ建設省に対し、新たな制裁を課したとマルコ・ルビオ上院議員が発表した。

articles.title: Peru earthquake damages buildings and causes power cuts
articles.description: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Ayacucho region on Thursday, the US Geological Survey says.
articles.titleJa: ペルー地震、建物に被害と停電を引き起こす
articles.summary: 木曜日にペルーのアヤクーチョ地域をマグニチュード6.7の地震が襲い、建物が損壊し、広範囲で停電が発生した。

articles.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
articles.description: The crucial waterway's operator says low rainfall caused by the ocean pattern had led to the decision.
articles.titleJa: パナマ運河、エルニーニョ現象のため通航船舶数を削減へ
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象による降雨量不足のため、パナマ運河の運営会社は通航できる船舶数を削減すると発表。世界の貿易に影響を与える。

articles.title: Goals, records, tears ... Messi's most iconic moments
articles.description: As Lionel Messi retires from international football following the death of his father, BBC Sport looks back at some of his most iconic moments.
articles.titleJa: ゴール、記録、涙…メッシの最も象徴的な瞬間
articles.summary: リオネル・メッシが父親の死を受けて代表サッカーからの引退を発表。BBCスポーツが彼の最も象徴的な瞬間を振り返った。

articles.title: The Argentine who wishes he could play for Wales
articles.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
articles.titleJa: ウェールズ代表入りを願うアルゼンチン人選手
articles.summary: ウェールズにルーツを持つチリ在住のアルゼンチン人DFジェレミアス・ジェームズが、ウェールズ代表でプレーするためのルール変更を望んでいる。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: ライブ配信者の殺人事件、メキシコのクリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問を投げかける
articles.summary: メキシコのコンテンツクリエイター、セサル・ガステルム氏の殺害事件が、インフルエンサーがなぜ襲撃されるのかという疑問を提起している。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安をもたらす
articles.summary: ベネズエラの地震により、子供たちは恐怖、日常の崩壊、基本的な栄養不足に苦しんでいる。家族は避難場所を求め、幼い子供たちが直面するトラウマ、避難、食料不安が深刻化している。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
articles.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力が高まる中、ブラジルでは土地紛争と先住民に対する殺害事件が増加している。先住民権利擁護団体は、土地の区画整理への圧力と権利の枠組みに関する行き詰まりが原因だと指摘する。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球のため息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティの断片
articles.summary: 「地球のため息」プロジェクトは、ドキュメンタリー写真、個人の証言、デジタル介入を組み合わせ、ベネズエラ地震後に十分に報道されなかったコミュニティの静かな余波を記録している。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラの二度の地震から1ヶ月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラの倒壊した建物のそばでは、数千人の親族が劣悪な状況と不十分な捜索支援にもかかわらず、行方不明の息子を探し続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで、無国籍の書類不備女性の物語に光を当てる裁判所の判決
articles.summary: ブラジルで、40年間書類も公的な身分もなかったボリビア生まれの女性が、裁判所の判決により移民の身分を正規化し、無国籍者としての認定手続きを開始できるようになった。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラは燃えている、そして私は遠くから見るしかない
articles.summary: メキシコシティから、ある亡命中のベネズエラ人が故国の崩壊をリアルタイムで目の当たりにする。避難、権威主義的な怠慢、生存と故郷の間の耐え難い距離が、彼女に無力感を突きつける。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアでの反体制派の沈黙
articles.summary: ニカラグアでは権威主義的な政権が、反体制派を沈黙させるために市民権剥奪という手段を「武器化」している状況について考察する。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラの復興にはどれくらいの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: 地震後のベネズエラの復興には、前例のない財源と長期的な経済回復努力が必要である。初期の損害見積もりは大きく異なるが、この結論は共通している。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラの命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコから、ベネズエラ人は数時間以内に動員し、信頼できるネットワークを構築して援助を届けた。これは、連帯が国境を越えられることを証明するものである。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察暴力支持への異議申し立てに貢献した方法
articles.summary: 2023年、ブラジルは世界有数の意図的な暴力死を記録。AI研究ツールが、この国を長年悩ませてきた大規模な警察暴力への国民の支持に異議を唱える手助けをした。

articles.title: Eleven people sentenced to death in Vietnam drug trafficking case
articles.description: More than 200 people are convicted over a network smuggling drugs into Vietnam in toothpaste tubes and other consumer items.
articles.titleJa: ベトナムの麻薬密売事件で11人に死刑判決
articles.summary: 歯磨き粉チューブなどに麻薬を隠してベトナムに密輸したネットワークで、200人以上が有罪判決を受け、11人に死刑が宣告された。

articles.title: US sailors go shopping before hitting the bars in Thailand after 250-day voyage
articles.description: With military haircuts and moustaches, the US sailors stand out against the flip-flops of the usual Pattaya crowd.
articles.titleJa: 米海軍兵、250日間の航海を終えタイで買い物とバーへ
articles.summary: 250日間の航海を終えた米海軍兵たちがタイのパタヤに上陸。軍人の身なりが地元の群衆の中で際立っている。

articles.title: Why Nepal floods should worry India
articles.description: The disaster comes as a warning as climate change raises shared Himalayan risks.
articles.titleJa: ネパールの洪水がインドを懸念させる理由
articles.summary: 気候変動がヒマラヤ地域全体の共有リスクを高める中、ネパールの洪水はインドにとって警告となっている。

articles.title: 'Nothing but mud and silt' - the village swept away by deadly floods in Nepal
articles.description: BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri spoke to a local, who is still waiting for his his wife's body to be retrieved, as rescue efforts continue.
articles.titleJa: 「泥と沈泥しかない」— ネパールの致命的な洪水で流された村
articles.summary: ネパールの致命的な洪水で村が流され、BBC特派員が妻の遺体回収を待つ地元住民に取材。救助活動が続いている。

articles.title: India's GDP growth defies oil shock but stirs up controversy
articles.description: India's 7.8% GDP growth has been met with scepticism over methodology and long-term durability due to a weak monsoon.
articles.titleJa: インドのGDP成長、原油ショックに逆行も論争を巻き起こす
articles.summary: インドのGDPが7.8%成長したものの、その算出方法と弱いモンスーンによる長期的な持続性について懐疑的な見方がされている。

articles.title: South Korea jails care home head for sexually assaulting disabled residents
articles.description: The man, surnamed Kim, was handed a 15-year prison term for abusing three residents at the facility near Seoul.
articles.titleJa: 韓国、障害者施設長に性的暴行で実刑判決
articles.summary: ソウル近郊の施設で、障害のある入居者3人に性的暴行を加えたとして、キムという男に15年の実刑判決が下された。

articles.title: Could the man who murdered a Christian missionary and his sons walk free in India?
articles.description: Dara Singh is serving a life sentence for burning alive Graham Staines and his two sons in Odisha in 1999.
articles.titleJa: キリスト教宣教師とその息子たちを殺害した男、インドで釈放される可能性は？
articles.summary: 1999年にグラハム・ステインズ宣教師とその2人の息子を焼き殺したダラ・シン受刑者が、終身刑から釈放される可能性について報じられている。

articles.title: Nepal intensifies relief and recovery efforts after deadly floods, UN says
articles.description: More than 1,200 people have died and thousands are missing, as rescue efforts continue and aid is airlifted to villages.
articles.titleJa: ネパール、致命的な洪水後に救援・復旧活動を強化、国連発表
articles.summary: ネパールで発生した致命的な洪水により1,200人以上が死亡、数千人が行方不明となる中、国連は救援・復旧活動が強化されていると発表した。

articles.title: Why US troops have a history in this raucous Thai city
articles.description: The BBC's Jonathan Head looks at the historical echoes of US troops arriving in Pattaya, a beach resort famous for its racy bars.
articles.titleJa: なぜ米軍がこの喧騒のタイの都市に歴史的なつながりを持つのか
articles.summary: BBCのジョナサン・ヘッド記者が、米軍が活気あるビーチリゾート、パタヤに到着した歴史的背景と、その社会への影響を考察する。

articles.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
articles.description: Major efforts to rescue hydropower workers continue as Nepal's death toll exceeds 1,000.
articles.titleJa: 川の水がトンネルを破壊し20分間追いかけてきた、ネパールの作業員がBBCに語る
articles.summary: ネパールの洪水で水力発電所の作業員が遭遇した恐怖体験を語る。死者数が1,000人を超える中、救助活動が続いている。

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels
articles.description: Global trade opens opportunities for economic growth. However, moving goods across borders, between exporters and importers, involves counterparty risk such as payment and liquidity risk. Trade finance facilitates trade by mitigating these risks.Using a new dataset, we find that volatile global financial conditions constrict the availability of trade finance, especially in emerging markets and developing countries. In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.
articles.titleJa: 貿易金融：不安定な金融情勢がその利用可能性と貿易水準にどのように影響するか
articles.summary: 不安定な金融情勢が貿易金融の利用可能性を制限し、特に新興市場国と途上国に影響を与えることを指摘。新しいデータに基づき、その影響を分析する。

articles.title: Public Forum 2026 programme is now available
articles.description: This year’s Public Forum, entitled Powering the Future, will feature 113 sessions – with a focus on trade in services – from 15 to 17 September. Sessions are organized by WTO member governments, businesses, non-governmental organizations, academia and international organizations, with many sessions livestreamed on the WTO website.
articles.titleJa: 2026年公開フォーラムのプログラムが発表
articles.summary: WTOの「未来を動かす」公開フォーラム（9月15日～17日）のプログラムが発表された。113のセッションでサービス貿易に焦点を当てる。

articles.title: WTO members adopt panel report regarding EU duties on fatty acid from Indonesia
articles.description: At a meeting on 28 August of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB), WTO members adopted a panel report regarding the European Union’s anti-dumping duties on imports of fatty acid from Indonesia.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、インドネシア産脂肪酸に対するEUの関税に関するパネル報告書を採択
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は、8月28日の紛争解決機関会議で、インドネシア産脂肪酸に対するEUのアンチダンピング関税に関するパネル報告書を採択した。

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on self-adhesive labels, packaging and certain other printed items
articles.description: On 28 August 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 13 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of self-adhesive labels, packaging and other printed items on paper, cardboard, plastics, textiles or other similar materials.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、自己粘着性ラベル、包装材などの印刷物に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは8月13日、自己粘着性ラベル、包装材、その他印刷物の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: Deadline to register for 2026 Public Forum is 21 August
articles.description: The deadline for online registration for this year’s in-person Public Forum, which will take place on 15, 16 and 17 September, is 21 August 2026 (23.59 CET). Late and onsite registrations will not be accepted.
articles.titleJa: 2026年公開フォーラムの登録締め切りは8月21日
articles.summary: 9月15日から17日に開催されるWTO公開フォーラムのオンライン登録締め切りは8月21日（中央ヨーロッパ時間23:59）であり、遅延登録は不可。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
articles.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
articles.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国は8月5日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易技術デー、AIを包摂的貿易に活用する政策を模索
articles.summary: WTOは初の「世界貿易技術デー」を開催し、AI戦略が国際貿易の利益を最大化する政策について議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 2026年第1四半期のグローバル物品貿易、中東戦争にもかかわらず回復力を示す
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の世界商品貿易は、AI関連電子部品の急増が中東紛争の影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税に関する紛争を開始
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国が自国製品に課した追加関税について、WTOとの紛争協議を要請した。これは米国通商法301条に基づく。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVおよびその他車両に関する措置の報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコ—電気自動車およびその他中国製車両に関する措置」（DS629）のパネル報告書を回覧した。
